desc:
🦸‍♂️ Welcome to +1 Superpower Destruction!

How to play:
💥DESTROY the map using your powers!
🍀Open PACKS to unlock new powers! There are 15 unlockable powers! Can you get them all?
⬆️ Upgrade luck, power, and more to get MORE powers and do MORE damage!
🔄️ Rebirth to keep stacking your buffs, and become a TOP PLAYER!

👍 Liking and favoriting the game would be greatly appreciated! ⭐

Thank you for playing, enjoy the game!
